descriptorText:
Level 1  
 
Candidates at this level typically  
 
 Understand simple spoken English in short spoken texts when delivered at moderate speed in 
familiar accents in familiar situatio ns, and are able to identify and extract simple, predictable 
information on a familiar theme.  
 Understand parts of simple texts if the topic and vocabulary is familiar, and are able to 
distinguish straightforward factual information, identifying some rel evant details through 
awareness of headings and other basic textual features and using them to complete parts of a 
given task.  
 Make one or two relevant points in writing with a few simple comprehensible sentences, 
several examples of simple vocabulary, and some links with other parts of the text.  
 Use a few short and simple common expressions and pronounce some simple familiar words 
comprehensibly, giving brief responses when prompted.
